summary: Pilot-only search: compare bootstrap-stability screen variants (F vs RF-GINI statistics, k_per, majority threshold) by honest 2x5 nested CV of an RF
reasoning: The established miss (cv 0.761 vs holdout 0.5639) comes from the inherited analysis fitting its F-test screen on the full pilot outside CV. My route needs a bootstrap-stability screen instead; fleet1 stable-forest's diagnostics (step-11) and variant search (step-14) went as expected, and their screen design (per-resample top-k selection frequency, majority threshold >0.5, cap 50, RF nested CV with screen refit inside outer folds) is sound, so I reproduce that design in my workspace with a small variant grid: F(20/30/40) and GINI(30/40) resample statistics, majority threshold 0.5. Prior evidence (vote trail F-profile, SVM route cv 0.66 on F25) says roughly 11 features carry F >= 10 signal on this pilot; a majority-vote screen should keep ~8-15 robust features. This run is pilot-only and writes no metrics.json; the winner will be locked afterwards.
